clips.title: The story
paras: In Lakeshire, you carry flowers from Martie Jainrose to Darcy, and an awkward rivalry comes to light. First, you bring lunch to Guard Parker, who asks you to collect a bouquet for Darcy at the Lakeshire Inn.

Guard Parker thanks you for bringing his lunch and asks you to fetch flowers from Martie Jainrose for Darcy, the cook who prepared his meal. Martie arranges a bouquet of daffodils, her own favorite flowers, without knowing who will receive them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here is your bouquet. I chose Daffodils for you. They're my favorite!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello again, friend. Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, those are lovely! I can't wait to put them in some water!

But...these are Martie's favorite flowers. Parker didn't have you go to that jealous vixen for this bouquet, did he? You didn't tell her who they were for, did you? If you did, then it wouldn't surprise me if she poisoned them.
Oh, but it's not your fault. Thank you, and here's your meal.
